content: Youth diagnosed with type 2 diabetes should undergo a comprehensive foot examination on an annual basis. This examination must include the evaluation of foot pulses, assessment of pinprick sensation, testing for vibration sensation, and monofilament testing. These assessments should be conducted using appropriate tools, such as a 128-Hz tuning fork for vibration testing and ankle reflex tests to evaluate neurological function. Preventive strategies should prioritize achieving optimal glycemic control to minimize the risk of developing diabetic neuropathy.
